content_text: Despite unexperience,  countless problems, difficulties of every kind, errors and mistakes, today we wrapped up the principal photography of our short movie! I know It won’t be a masterpiece and a simply acceptable result Is my goal, yet i wanted to celebrate here too since Roger, David and you all have had, with your example and advices, a huge role in pushing me forward when everybody was telling me to give up!
